_comment: Windows app list, the counterpart of the Linux packages.yml/install roles and macos/Brewfile. source=winget installs via winget (portable packages go to <EmulatorsRoot>\<installDir>); source=github downloads the latest release asset matching assetPattern into <EmulatorsRoot>\<installDir>; source=manual cannot be automated (the site blocks scripted downloads) and only prints instructions. emulatorNames are the ES-DE find-rule names bootstrap.ps1 writes into custom_systems\es_find_rules.xml. Every entry installs without Administrator rights: apps with an official portable build use it (source github/gitlab/url) instead of their installer. source=gitlab reads a GitLab project's latest release links; source=url finds the newest version in versionIndexUrl with versionRegex and downloads urlTemplate.

apps.name: RetroArch
apps.notes: Cores are installed separately by install-cores.ps1.

apps.name: Dolphin
apps.notes: dolphin-emu.org and its mirror answer 403 to scripted downloads, and winget only has the 2016 5.0 release. Download the latest release .7z in a browser and extract it so Dolphin.exe ends up in <EmulatorsRoot>\Dolphin-x64\.

apps.name: RPCS3
apps.notes: Official RPCS3 Windows builds. Needs the PS3 firmware (PS3UPDAT.PUP) installed through its own GUI.

apps.name: Eden
apps.notes: Needs your own prod.keys and firmware, same as on Linux.

apps.name: Xenia Canary
apps.notes: Native on Windows -- the Linux tree needs Wine and Xenia Manager for this.

apps.name: MAME
apps.notes: Runs Sega Model 1, and is an alternative emulator for Model 2/3 and the arcade systems.

apps.name: Model 2 Emulator
apps.notes: ElSemi's Model 2 Emulator has no official download host or release feed. Extract it so EMULATOR.EXE ends up in <EmulatorsRoot>\m2emulator\. configure-emulators.ps1 points its [RomDirs] at your model2 ROM folder. MAME is offered as an alternative emulator for model2 in ES-DE.

apps.name: Eden Cheats Manager
apps.notes: Windows build of the Linux install_eden_cheats_manager tool (the Linux role uses its AppImage). Per-user NSIS installer run silently.

apps.name: Python
apps.notes: Official portable (embeddable) Python, only used by content.ps1 to run the same helper scripts as the Linux roles (PS3/Switch DLC extraction, RPCS3 per-game configs, IPS/BPS ROM patches). extract_ps3_dlc.py needs the cryptography package, so pip is enabled and it is installed from its prebuilt wheel.

apps.name: OpenBOR
apps.notes: On Windows ES-DE launches OpenBOR games as per-game folders with their own OpenBOR.exe (copy this engine into each game folder). See windows/README.md.

apps.name: Ship of Harkinian
apps.notes: Ocarina of Time PC port (Linux install_ship_of_harkinian). First launch asks for your OoT ROM and builds oot.o2r.

apps.name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian
apps.notes: Majora's Mask PC port. First launch asks for your MM ROM.

apps.name: Starship
apps.notes: Star Fox 64 PC port. First launch extracts assets from your Star Fox 64 (USA) (Rev A) ROM.

apps.name: SpaghettiKart
apps.notes: Mario Kart 64 PC port. First launch asks for your MK64 ROM.

apps.name: Banjo-Kazooie Recompiled
apps.notes: N64Recomp port. Select your Banjo-Kazooie (USA) ROM in its launcher.

apps.name: Donkey Kong 64 Recompiled
apps.notes: N64Recomp port. Select your Donkey Kong 64 (USA) ROM in its launcher.

apps.name: Wave Race 64 Recompiled
apps.notes: N64Recomp port (runs under Wine on Linux, native here). Select your Wave Race 64 (USA) (Rev A) ROM.

apps.name: Metroid Prime Hunters Recomp
apps.notes: Needs your Metroid Prime - Hunters (USA) ROM.

apps.name: Perfect Dark
apps.notes: Perfect Dark PC port. Put your Perfect Dark (USA) (Rev A) ROM in its data folder as pd.ntsc-final.z64.

apps.name: Donkey Kong Country Recomp
apps.notes: SNES recomp; needs the USA v1.0 ROM. Linux builds it from source with its own patches; upstream ships Windows builds.

apps.name: Donkey Kong Country 2 Recomp
apps.notes: SNES recomp; needs the USA v1.0 ROM.

apps.name: Donkey Kong Country 3 Recomp
apps.notes: SNES recomp; needs the USA ROM.

apps.name: Super Mario Bros. Remastered
apps.notes: Godot remake; asks for your Super Mario Bros. ROM on first launch.

apps.name: Super Mario World Remastered
apps.notes: Godot remake; asks for your Super Mario World (USA) ROM on first launch.

apps.name: Sonic 3 A.I.R.
apps.notes: Asks for your Sonic 3 & Knuckles ROM on first launch.

apps.name: Sonic 2 (2013) - RSDKv4
apps.notes: RSDKv4 decompilation; copy your Sonic 2 (2013) Data.rsdk next to the exe. The Linux Sonic 2 Mania mod goes in its mods folder.

apps.name: Cannonball DX (OutRun)
apps.notes: OutRun engine; put your OutRun MAME romset files in its roms folder.

apps.name: DUDE (Doom 3)
apps.notes: Doom 3 source port; needs your Doom 3 game files.

apps.name: Dusk (Twilight Princess)
apps.notes: Twilight Princess PC port; select your GameCube disc image in its launcher.

apps.name: Unleashed Recompiled
apps.notes: Its first-run installer asks for your Sonic Unleashed (Xbox 360) game files and title update.

apps.name: Star Fox Enhanced
apps.notes: SNES Star Fox source port; builds assets from your Star Fox (USA) (Rev 2) ROM on first launch.

apps.name: TriAevum
apps.notes: Ocarina of Time 3D PC port (Wine on Linux, native here); TriAevumForge extracts your OoT3D ROM.

apps.name: WipEout Phantom Edition
apps.notes: Needs the original WipEout PC/PS1 data files (see docs/wipeout-pe.md).

apps.name: G-Diffuser (F-Zero X)
apps.notes: F-Zero X port; needs your F-Zero X ROM (plus the Expansion Kit disk and 64DD IPL for the Expansion Kit).

apps.name: PrBoom+ RT (Doom II Ray Traced)
apps.notes: Ray-traced Doom; copy your doom2.wad next to the exe.

apps.name: Virtua Racing (Wanszai)
apps.notes: Model 1 frontend (Wine on Linux, native here); put vr.zip in its roms folder.

apps.name: Virtua Fighter (Wanszai)
apps.notes: Model 1 frontend; put vf.zip in its roms folder.

apps.name: Ridge Racer Collection (Wanszai)
apps.notes: System 22 frontend (Ridge Racer, RR2, Rave Racer); put the MAME romsets in its roms folder.

apps.name: Sega Rally HD (Wanszai)
apps.notes: Model 2 Sega Rally frontend; put srallyc.zip in its roms folder.

apps.name: Streets of Rage Remake
apps.notes: Windows fan game (Wine on Linux, native here), same archive.org source as the Linux role.

apps.name: Sonic P-06
apps.notes: Project 06 Silver Release has no scripted download; extract it so "Sonic the Hedgehog.exe" is in <EmulatorsRoot>\sonic-p06.

apps.name: Sonic SMS Remake
apps.notes: No scripted download; extract v1.9 so "Sonic SMS Remake.exe" is in <EmulatorsRoot>\sonic-sms-remake.

apps.name: DKLR
apps.notes: No scripted download; extract it so DKLR.exe is in <EmulatorsRoot>\dklr.

apps.name: Parallel Launcher
apps.notes: Its GitLab releases carry no files; install from the official site. Also the n64 alternative emulator in ES-DE.

apps.name: Hedge Mod Manager
apps.notes: Sonic mod manager (Linux builds it from source; the Windows release is a single exe).

apps.name: Xenia Manager
apps.notes: Per-game Xenia configs and title updates (Linux install_xenia runs it under Wine). Xenia Canary itself is installed as a core emulator.

apps.name: Overstrike
apps.notes: Marvel's Spider-Man mod manager (Linux install_modtools).

apps.name: Ryu Mod Manager
apps.notes: Yakuza mod manager (Linux install_modtools).

apps.name: SnakeBite
apps.notes: MGSV mod manager (Linux install_modtools); its interactive installer must be run by hand.

apps.name: DOSBox Staging
apps.notes: For the Screamer DOS games (Linux install_screamer); point it at your own game copies.

apps.name: Cheat Engine
apps.notes: Linux install_cheatengine; the official installer bundles offers, so install it by hand.
